svg.title: An ancient oval through four times
svg.desc: Numerical rotational mean curvature flow from a long convex seed in three-space. Four surfaces at times minus 1000, minus 10, minus 1 and minus 0.001, all divided by square root of minus time and drawn at one common scale. Elongated shapes become round. Finite-seed computation, not certified ancient-flow data.

g.text: Ancient oval · a flow through time
Surface case n = 2, j = 1 · numerical MCF from a long convex seed
Parabolic rescaling: every surface is divided by √(−t), at one common drawing scale.
Original scale: all slices shrink to the origin as t → 0. Rescaled limit: a sphere of radius 2.
Haslhofer–Hershkovits, Theorem 1.1 and §3 · finite-seed approximation; no certified error to the ancient flow.
